content: {"reasoning":"Authorization is required, but silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; a formal appeal is unavailable until a denial exists. Submitting with supporting records initiates payer adjudication within the filing deadline and documents medical necessity, although records do not replace authorization. The payer path is not exhausted, so billing the full balance to the patient or writing it off is premature.","action":"submit_with_records"}
